set.body: Amend the approved artifact contract and implement two consumer-facing improvements. First, add a publishable browser-safe reframe4s umbrella artifact whose transitive dependencies provide the stable runtime transformation stack without requiring users to select granular modules; exclude law, reference-oracle, and experimental artifacts. Second, convert image4s-nifti from JVM-only to a JVM and Scala.js cross-project. Share byte-level NIfTI-1 parsing and encoding; retain platform-specific filesystem and gzip adapters; support uncompressed and gzip single and pair files, extensions, and every accepted numeric encoding on Node.js. Keep image4s-core format-free. The Scala.js artifact is explicitly Node-only and must not imply browser filesystem support. Update PRD.json, the concrete consumer-to-dependency DAG, guides, and status. Acceptance: graph and PRD checks pass; JVM NIfTI suite remains green; Node Scala.js tests cover single/pair, gzip, extensions, and the datatype matrix; the umbrella compiles on JVM and Scala.js; generated POM or dependency inspection proves transitive runtime dependencies.
set.title: Add the reframe4s umbrella and Node NIfTI I/O
